concept: Step Functions: Standard vs Express for long-running orchestration
tests: Choosing a service to orchestrate a multi-step process with retries, branching, and auditing that runs for hours.
expected: Step Functions Standard workflow: retries, error handling, branching, exactly-once, executions up to 1 year, full visual history of every execution. Triggers: "coordinate several steps", "audit trail", "run for hours".
why_not: Express runs up to 5 minutes, at-least-once, limited history; an SNS→Lambda chain has no centralized state or audit; one big Lambda is limited to 15 minutes and fragile.
